notes: The PDF text extraction gave only the page images and no inventory pages, so Element IDs were not available. I matched pieces to the catalogue by appearance. Several choices are guesses: the two grille slopes, the dark grey 2x6 plate, the black 2x4 brick in step 11, the clear grille in step 12, and the wing pieces in step 13.
The curved fender (step 7) and the flame piece (step 10) are not in the catalogue, so I made two new types. They use placeholder ids, not real Element IDs.
The yellow 1x1 lights in step 7 are modelled as trans-yellow 1x1 slopes (lego-4260942).

The two trans-red 1x1 round plates in step 8 are attached to the underside of the 4x4 plate. The wheel holders are also modelled as attached under the 4x4 plate. The underside view in step 8 does not clearly confirm either position.
Step 4 adds two wheel holders with pins. Step 14 adds four wheels, each a hub and a tyre, mounted on those pins. Only the two rear wheels are visible in the final picture.
Studs are assumed to be pushed on by hand and rigid. Wheels on pins are revolute.
